observations.footwork: Fighter stays in stance, making small weight shifts while moving into pad range.
observations.guard: Hands held high in boxing guard; right hand extends then returns to guard.
observations.upper_body: Torso rotates to drive a straight right hand toward the pad.
observations.distance: Close, at pad-work distance with both fighters maintaining contact range.
observations.notable: First punch sequence of the window.

observations.footwork: Fighter adjusts feet slightly to reset position.
observations.guard: Hands remain high in guard between strikes.
observations.upper_body: Fighter throws another straight punch, rotating the shoulders.
observations.notable: Second punch sequence; includes load and extension.

observations.guard: Guard is held up, with recovery back to position after punch.
observations.upper_body: Third punch thrown, followed by a return to neutral boxing stance.
observations.notable: Third and final punch in the window; ends in stance.

movement_events.detail: Right hand extends toward the pad.
Hand retracts and guard is re-established.
Fighter loads weight and prepares to strike.
Second straight punch reaches the pad.
Fighter begins third punch, loading the rear hand.
Third punch extends toward the pad.
Punch retracts and guard returns to normal.
